extracted.intended_audience: Agency ADP customer/user offices and ADP service organizations (e.g., OER, OSX, OP, OF, FMSAC, GCS, BID, CBS, NPIC) and agency directors responsible for ADP submissions
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing office submissions to the Semiannual Report on ADP Accomplishments required by OMB Circular A-79, covering Section I (applications/use of computers) and Section II (ADP operations management accomplishments) for the first half of FY1972.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I: Describe new or revised ADP applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs for Section I should describe new and revised ADP applications; 'Describe and explain the benefits of each NEW OR REVISED computer-based system implemented during this report period.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information normally furnished by ADP customer/user offices. The report period is the first half of the fiscal year (July through December 1971). Section III (plans for the future) is not required in this mid-fiscal year report.

rubrics_metrics.name: System description (Section I.A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly identify and explain the intelligence (or other) functions and objectives which the computerized system supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include identification of the Agency Program supported (i.e., category, subcategory, element, etc.), identify and explain any contractor involvement, and indicate any community interest or use of the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimate personnel savings (Section I.B.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your estimate and briefly explain the number of additional people (or man years) that would be required for the Agency to accomplish the objectives of this computer-based system if we were to perform the necessary functions manually (i.e., without a computer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide rationale for the estimate; quantify in people or man-years so the agency can assess labor savings attributable to the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe other benefits (Section I.B.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly explain other benefits of this computerized system such as increases in efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List and explain benefits beyond personnel savings (examples given: efficiency, timeliness, accuracy). Provide concrete examples where possible of improvements achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II: ADP management accomplishments — general
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs for Section II should describe computer operations management accomplishments and 'Describe and explain the benefits of significant ADP operations management accomplishments... Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar savings which should result.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information normally furnished by ADP service organizations (e.g., GCS, BID, CBS, NPIC). For each accomplishment include estimated equipment, manpower, or dollar savings resulting from the activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardization or integration of computer systems (Section II.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardisation or integration of computer systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting, explain benefits (e.g., reduced duplication, interoperability), and furnish estimates of equipment, manpower, or dollar savings expected from standardization/integration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improvements in ADP methods or technology (Section II.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Improvements in ADP methods or technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the methodological or technological improvements, their operational impact, and provide estimates of resulting savings or performance gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiation of ADP contracts under favorable terms (Section II.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms than provided in the Federal Supply Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document contract improvements, compare terms to Federal Supply Schedule baseline, and estimate equipment/manpower/dollar savings or other benefits arising from the negotiated terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress in handling ADP security problems (Section II.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress in handling ADP security problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe security problem mitigation actions, improvements in security posture, and any measurable benefits or reductions in risk/costs. Include estimates of savings or resource impacts where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems (Section II.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize R&D accomplishments or milestones, potential operational benefits, anticipated savings or capabilities, and expected next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification and submission handling
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency's report to the International Programs Division, OMB will be classified at the security level indicated by your submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure submissions are marked with the appropriate security classification; classification of the aggregate report will follow the highest level indicated by component submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness/deadline for responses
rubrics_metrics.description: Please furnish your response to me by 24 January 1972.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the specified deadline for submission; late inputs may affect inclusion in the semiannual report to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantify and explain tangible savings for Section II items
rubrics_metrics.description: For Section II accomplishments: 'Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar savings which should result.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed type of management accomplishment (standardization, method improvements, contract negotiation, security, R&D), include quantitative estimates in equipment, manpower or dollars and explain how estimates were derived.
